photos.title: Mar Vista Grande from above
photos.what: Mar Vista Grande from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the oceanfront tower with terracotta-colored roofs stands in the middle, on the dunes and beach, with Ocean Boulevard behind it; the beach and the Atlantic Ocean run along the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: Mar Vista Grande from above, on the beach, with Ocean Boulevard behind it.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Mar Vista Grande tower on the oceanfront in North Myrtle Beach, labelled, with Ocean Boulevard behind it and the Atlantic Ocean in front
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023, natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling, mosaic locked to Year=2023) on 2026-11-15; the exact request is in source_request.
